confirmedFindings.title: Two-tier cache update invalidates L2 Redis without clearing local L1 memory cache across instances
confirmedFindings.body: Invalidating only the local L1 cache instance and L2 Redis causes other horizontal service instances with cached L1 memory copies to serve stale data.
confirmedFindings.suggestion: Publish a Redis Pub/Sub invalidation broadcast to notify all worker instances to purge their local L1 memory stores.
